name: Kitchen and home appliance parts
meta_description: Printed plastic parts for fridges, dryers, dishwashers and vacuums: door bins, knobs, clips and triggers. Photo in, quote in 24 hours.
intro: When a plastic bin, knob, clip or trigger breaks, the appliance is often fine but the part is out of stock or sold only in a costly assembly. We print the plastic piece to order from your model number and photos, and we never touch electrical parts. Products in this category: Whirlpool and KitchenAid fridge door bin, Samsung fridge door bin, Maytag and Whirlpool dryer knob, Bosch dishwasher tine clip and Dyson V11 trigger.
